REAL_SANDBOX.label: Real Sandbox call
REAL_SANDBOX.meaning: A real call to PayPal's Sandbox through TradeGlot, made by the author with two Sandbox test accounts. Sandbox test data, not a real merchant case. Rows marked refused before any send call are refusals: TradeGlot sent no evidence to that dispute.

RECORDED.label: Recorded real run
RECORDED.meaning: A real run against an outside service (Channel3 search, Gemini) made once and recorded in the file named. This page shows the record; it calls nothing.

TEST.label: Automated test
TEST.meaning: An in-process test or attack round with a mocked PayPal transport. Nothing outside the repository is called.

SYNTHETIC.label: Synthetic data
SYNTHETIC.meaning: Demo data generated by the app and labelled Synthetic in the console. There is no real source behind it.

rows.proven: The generated Postman collection was driven by Newman against the local console on 2026-11-09 in two runs: a 10-request read-only subset (19 assertions) and a 25-request run collection covering 21 of the 37 operations (82 assertions); none failed.
rows.how: A read-only subset (the session request and 9 GET requests that need no path parameter) ran against a local server in default demo mode: no PayPal Sandbox keys, no Gemini key, no network beyond loopback. The first unmodified run was refused (403 origin_required, then 401) until the two required headers were added. That first run left the 27 other requests unrun and shows nothing about the hosted site or PayPal calls. The second run used the 25-request run collection, which covers 21 of the 37 operations, carries the headers and a test on every request, and includes 3 deliberate negative cases that answered 422 as expected. The 16 operations that reach PayPal or a model were not run.

rows.proven: TradeGlot's API description passed APIMatic validation with 0 errors on 2026-11-09 after the first run failed with 345; the generated documentation portal was later published as static pages and the SDKs were generated locally.
rows.how: APIMatic CLI 1.5.0 on the generated OpenAPI file (37 operations). The first run failed on duplicate schema titles and one exclusive bound; the export tool was fixed, and the second run succeeded. Portal, llms.txt and SDKs for seven languages were produced; the portal was then published on GitHub Pages and opened in a browser. The portal is documentation only (the API runs locally), its request and response examples were added later the same day (19 media types still have none), no Copilot answer has been checked, and the SDKs were not run against the API.

recorded_send.intro: The evidence send of 2026-11-05 (UTC+8) in PayPal Sandbox, as written in the committed receipt. Times in the steps are UTC: 2026-11-04 16:58 to 17:16 UTC is 2026-11-05 00:58 to 01:16 UTC+8. This page makes no PayPal call: it only shows what the receipt records.
